lines.text: A bot fires a thousand requests at once: what happens to number 101?
The token bucket gains twenty tokens per second, up to a hundred, and each request spends one.
With no token left comes error four hundred and twenty-nine, without calling the service, so the burst passes only up to the bucket size.
In this simulation, normal clients went from almost three seconds to 51 milliseconds.
The bot took nine hundred rejections, and a legitimate spike bigger than the bucket would get the same: rate and bucket size are the decision.
What bucket size would you pick for your API?
